**A.** Response A is far closer to the "under 120 words" limit. By my count it runs to about 123 words, so it slightly exceeds the limit. Response B runs to roughly 190 words, so it breaks the constraint by a wide margin.

Both responses cover chaining, open addressing, average versus worst-case performance, and resizing. A also adds amortized O(1) insertion, while B adds the O(log n) tree-bucket worst case and the clustering note. A is also more concise and has no filler opener, whereas B begins with "Let me explain how collisions work."
